annotations.title: Compare a vehicle's price to like units

description: Price context for one vehicle against like units across the network (same make, model, exact model year, condition; optional trim and geo). Example: {"identity": "<VIN>", "rooftop_slug": "mms"} or {"make": "Subaru", "model": "Outback", "model_year": 2024, "condition": "used"}. Returns count, price quartiles, the subject's rank and up to 5 cheapest peers. Advertised prices only; call quote_preview for a total. Pass country=CA for Canadian dealers.

inputSchema.description: Server-enforced: latitude requires longitude; longitude requires latitude; radius_miles requires latitude and longitude. Exactly one of identity | make+model+model_year is required. Additional argument rules are enforced server-side.

country.description: Market to search; rooftops in the other country are excluded. Prices are in that country's currency; the radius stays in miles.

name: inventory_comparables
